data: Apple spent more on research and development than Microsoft in fiscal 2025. Apple's R&D expense was about $34.55 billion for the fiscal year ended in late September 2025, and Microsoft's was about $32.49 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025. Apple's figure is roughly 1.06 times Microsoft's, or about 6% larger. These figures are from my training data rather than a live filing check, so please verify them against each company's FY2025 10-K before relying on them.
